# Qwen3-VL end-to-end seams (a REAL image file)

Generated by `../../../examples/refgen/qwen3vl_e2e_ref.py` on the M3 Ultra (100.100.141.123),
transformers 5.1.0 / torch 2.11.0, checkpoint snapshot `9f2f7e71…`.

Unlike every other fixture here the pixels are **not synthesised**: they come from
`../qwen3vl_preproc/probe.ppm` through the real `Qwen2VLImageProcessorFast`, so this is the only
check that exercises the **preprocessing → tower** seam.

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `ref.final` | `[14, 2048]` `last_hidden_state` for the image + prompt |
| `ref.meta`  | ids, modality types, grid, image positions, marker token ids |

⛔ `pixel_values` is NOT duplicated here — byte-identical to `../qwen3vl_preproc/probe.pixel_values`.

⛔ The image run is bracketed by `<vision_start>`/`<vision_end>`. Without those markers transformers
finds zero images and mRoPE silently never fires; the generator asserts the three position axes are
not identical so that cannot recur.
